name: NEXORA Community Starter Pack
description: Small local UI enhancements. Review every plugin before installing.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Reduce motion
plugins.description: Accessibility: Disable nonessential Discord animations and transitions.

plugins.name: NEXORA • High contrast
plugins.description: Accessibility: Boost contrast for text and interactive controls.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Readable typography
plugins.description: Accessibility: Use a clean system font and improve line spacing.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Wide chat
plugins.description: Layout: Use more horizontal space for messages.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Compact messages
plugins.description: Layout: Reduce vertical gaps between messages.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Square corners
plugins.description: Appearance: Reduce rounded corners across common cards and buttons.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Underline links
plugins.description: Readability: Always underline links in chat for clarity.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Wrap code blocks

plugins.description: Focus: Tone down avatar prominence.

plugins.description: Accessibility: Make keyboard focus easier to see.

plugins.name: NEXORA • Sticky message composer

plugins.name: NEXORA • Hide channel topic
